plugins.name: ai-bridge
plugins.description: The OKF control panel as a Claude Code plugin — /brief-me, /capture, /work, /dispatch, /handoff, /welcome, /new-project, /close-project, /answer, /audit, /board, /fanout, /pr-review-request, plus the two PreToolUse enforcement hooks and the eight role agents.

plugins.name: ai-bridge-yolo
plugins.description: COMPANION to ai-bridge. Ships AUTONOMY.md, the capability file that defines the `yolo` mode — the loop may promote fully-refined build drafts and merge on an independent clearance. Not installed = every project is gated. A companion ADDS behaviour and never removes a core gate.

plugins.name: ai-bridge-accounts
plugins.description: COMPANION to ai-bridge. Ships companion/accounts.md and bin/ai-bridge-claude — a bundle names its Claude account in instance.config.json, the launcher starts claude on it, and core's welcome banner says which account is active. Not installed = core prints no account line and switches nothing. A companion ADDS behaviour and never removes a core gate.
